info.name: Herlan REST API
info.description: Postman/Apidog collection for the Herlan WordPress REST API plugin (namespace herlan/v1). Every request requires Woo-Consumer-Key / Woo-Consumer-Secret headers (set automatically by the collection's pre-request script from collection variables). Authenticated endpoints additionally require `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`, captured automatically from /auth/login or /auth/register. Cart endpoints use a rotating Cart-Token header, handled by the Cart folder's own pre-request/test scripts.

exec: // Site-wide gate: every herlan/v1 request must carry Woo-Consumer-Key / Woo-Consumer-Secret.

item.name: App / Misc
item.description: Site-wide config endpoints used by the app shell: version/status, promo bar, header theming, and the promotional image popup. All public.

request.description: Returns basic API/site info (version, site name, timezone). Public, no auth beyond the Woo consumer key gate.
Returns the top promo bar configuration (enabled flag, background color, text) from theme settings.
Returns header/nav bar color settings, mini-cart badge color, and header ornament configuration.
Returns the configured promotional image popup (desktop/mobile image, display location, re-show interval, CTA URL).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, registration, and logout for the mobile app's own bearer-token auth (independent of any JWT plugin). Login/Register issue an access_token used as `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` on every authenticated endpoint below.

request.description: Authenticates a user with username/password and issues a bearer access token (format base64(user_id).secret) valid 30 days.

exec: // Non-JSON or error response — nothing to capture.

request.description: Creates a new WordPress/WooCommerce customer account (if registration is enabled) and issues a bearer access token.

exec: // Non-JSON or error response — nothing to capture.

request.description: Revokes the bearer token used on this request (removes it from the user's stored token list). Requires authentication.

item.name: Home
item.description: The home-screen content bundle (hero slider, promo blocks, product groups, campaigns, brands, etc.), served as one cached payload.

request.description: Returns the full home-screen bundle: hero slider, promotional block, campaign shortcuts, product groups, campaigns, categories block, custom tags, product sliders, home video, brands, and shop-by-category. Cached 15 minutes and cron-warmed every 10 minutes.

item.name: Taxonomies
item.description: Product taxonomy browsing endpoints (categories, brands, and all filterable taxonomies) used to power navigation drawers and category pickers.

query.description: Only return terms with products. Default true.
Return categories as a flat list instead of a nested tree. Default false.

request.description: Returns product categories (optionally as a flat list or nested tree) and brands, for the app's navigation drawer.

query.description: Only return terms with products. Default true.

request.description: Returns every filterable product taxonomy (category, brand, tag, keywords, skin-type, age-range, and any public pa_ attribute) with their terms. Cached 15 minutes.

item.name: Product Listing & Filters
item.description: The main product listing/search endpoint (/group/products) plus the supporting filter-config, filter-terms, and filter-forms endpoints used to build filter UIs.

query.description: Taxonomy to scope the listing to, e.g. product_cat, product_tag, brand.

request.description: Main product listing/search endpoint used for category/tag/brand archives and filtered search. Supports context taxonomy scoping, multi-facet filter_* params, price range, sorting, and pagination.
Returns the list of available filter definitions (taxonomy filters, price, sort-by) for building a filter UI, scoped to an optional context taxonomy/term.

query.description: Required. Taxonomy to list terms for.

request.description: Returns the terms (with product counts within the current context/pool) for a single filter taxonomy, e.g. for populating a brand filter's checkbox list.
Returns a WooCommerce Advanced Product Filters (wcapf) form definition, resolved into the api_param keys /group/products understands, scoped to an optional context taxonomy/term.

item.name: Products
item.description: Single product detail, legacy filter metadata, reviews, Q&A, and bundle slot selection.

request.description: Returns sort options, price range, and available taxonomy filters (with counts) for a product context. Cached 10 minutes.
Returns full product detail: pricing, images, attributes/variations, linked products, bundle slots (if a bundle product), and related data.
Returns paginated approved reviews for a product.
Submits a new review (rating + content) for a product. Requires authentication.
Returns paginated Q&A entries for a product.
Submits a new question about a product. Optional authentication: send a bearer token if available to attribute the question to a logged-in user, otherwise it's submitted as a guest.
Returns the paginated, searchable list of selectable child products for one slot (index) of an Easy Product Bundle.

item.name: Search
item.description: Product search with an optional per-user search history and site-wide popular searches.

query.description: When true and authenticated, saves this phrase to the user's search history.

request.description: Full-text product search (via FiboSearch/Ajax Search for WooCommerce when available, else a native WP_Query fallback). Optional authentication: send a bearer token so remember=true can save the phrase to the user's history.
Returns site-wide popular search phrases plus the current user's own recent search history (empty for guests). Optional authentication.
Clears the authenticated user's own saved search history. Does not affect site-wide popular searches. Requires authentication.

item.name: Cart
item.description: Guest/authenticated cart management. Uses a rotating Cart-Token header instead of cookies — see the folder's pre-request/test scripts.

request.description: Returns the current cart contents, totals, applied coupons, BOGO/free-shipping/Herlan Cash info. Uses the Cart-Token header instead of cookies; optional bearer auth links the cart session to a logged-in user.
Adds a product (simple, variation, or bundle) to the cart.
Updates the quantity of an existing cart item; setting quantity to 0 removes it.
Removes a single item from the cart by its cart item key.
Empties the entire cart.
Returns editable detail for a single cart item (product images, linked products, attributes, variations) for building an in-cart edit sheet. Response has no cart object.
Swaps an existing cart item for a different product/variation (used by the cart item editor), preserving or overriding quantity.
Applies a coupon code to the cart.
Removes a previously applied coupon from the cart.
Enables or disables applying the user's Herlan Cash loyalty balance to the cart. Requires authentication.
Sets a specific Herlan Cash amount to redeem against the cart (clamped to the nearest 10 and to the max redeemable). Requires authentication.

exec: // Cart endpoints use a rotating Cart-Token header instead of cookies.
// Every cart response returns a fresh cart_token that must be sent back on the next request.
// GET /cart/item-editor/{key} has no cart object in its response — nothing to capture.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Checkout summary, shipping/payment method selection, order placement, post-payment completion, and order cancellation.

request.description: Returns available payment methods, shipping methods, and Herlan Cash info for the current cart/address context, before placing the order.
Returns the list of enabled WooCommerce payment gateways. Requires authentication.
Selects a shipping rate for the current cart's shipping package and recalculates totals.
Creates a WooCommerce order from the current cart and billing/shipping details, then initiates payment via the selected gateway. Rate-limited to 10 attempts/hour per user or IP.
Clears the cart once the client confirms the customer returned from the payment flow — only if the order is actually paid — and returns recommended products for the thank-you page.
Cancels an unpaid order (pending/on-hold/failed) on the customer's behalf.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment status polling and SSLCommerz verification fallback for orders placed via /checkout.

request.description: Placeholder endpoint: currently always returns an empty methods list. Requires authentication.
Placeholder endpoint: mobile payment gateway integration is pending; returns null payment with a 202 status. Requires authentication.

query.description: Required for guest orders instead of authentication.

request.description: Returns the authoritative payment/order status for an order, for the app to poll after a WebView payment flow ends. Guests must supply order_key.
Fallback confirmation for SSLCommerz orders whose browser return-leg never fired: asks SSLCommerz directly for the transaction status and updates the order accordingly.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Authenticated order history/detail, public guest order tracking, and invoice download.

request.description: Returns the authenticated customer's paginated order history. Requires authentication.
Returns full detail for a single order owned by the authenticated customer. Requires authentication.
Public order lookup by order number + billing email/phone, used by the Track Order page for both guests and logged-in users.

query.description: Required for guest orders instead of authentication.

request.description: Streams a PDF (via WooCommerce PDF Invoices & Packing Slips if active, else an HTML fallback) for a confirmed order. Logged-in users must own the order; guests must supply order_key.

item.name: Account & User
item.description: Authenticated user profile, avatar, loyalty summary, and coupon endpoints.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile plus total_orders, wishlist_count, and address_count. Requires authentication.
Updates the authenticated user's profile fields, email, and/or password. current_password is required when changing email or password. Requires authentication.
Uploads a profile photo (multipart form field 'avatar', max 3 MB, JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP). Requires authentication.

Returns the authenticated user's Herlan Loyalty summary (points, available cash, level/tier progress, recent transactions) proxied from the external loyalty API. Cached 5 minutes. Requires authentication.
Returns the authenticated user's available, expired, or used Smart Coupons. Requires authentication.
Returns the authenticated user's paginated wishlist items with product summaries. Requires authentication.
Adds a product (or a specific variation) to the authenticated user's wishlist. Requires authentication.
Removes a product (or a specific variation) from the authenticated user's wishlist. Requires authentication.

item.name: Store Locator
item.description: Public physical store directory and location list.

request.description: Returns a paginated, filterable (district/area/search) list of physical store locations.
Returns detail for a single published store location.
Returns the distinct list of districts and their areas across all published stores, for building a location picker.

item.name: Blog
item.description: Public blog post listing and detail endpoints.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of published blog posts, optionally filtered by category or tag term ID.
Returns all blog post categories that have at least one published post.
Returns a single published post by ID, including full content, custom fields, and relevant products.
Returns a single published post by its slug.
